characters.name: Vesle Aase Gaasepige
characters.prompt: A young Norwegian girl dressed in simple country attire, with a humble and determined expression, sitting among geese in a lush green meadow. She is skillfully mending a piece of cloth, embodying simplicity and resilience.

characters.name: Prinsen fra Engeland
characters.prompt: A handsome prince with noble features, wearing elegant medieval attire. He stands with an air of confidence and curiosity, holding a mysterious stone that glows with magical energy, symbolizing his royal status.

characters.name: Stenen
characters.prompt: A magical, slightly glowing stone placed prominently in a luxurious medieval bedroom. It has an ethereal aura and intricate carvings that suggest its ability to reveal secrets.

characters.name: Prinsesser
characters.prompt: A series of beautiful princesses from different lands, each dressed in extravagant medieval gowns, each with a unique demeanor ranging from joyous to concerned. They are surrounded by an air of mystery and elegance.

Include the mystical stone glowing near a grand royal carriage, evoking a sense of fantasy and folklore.
